title: Cooking Without Waiting
lede: A short animated film from PK Explains. Why PostgreSQL 18 stops standing in line for the disk. Story cut for everyone; switch on Engineer's cut for every technical detail.
logline: Why PostgreSQL 18 stops standing in line for the disk.
topic: PostgreSQL 18 asynchronous I/O: synchronous reads, OS read-ahead, io_method worker and io_uring, io_workers, I/O combining, read-ahead distance, effective_io_concurrency, limits (writes, cache hits)
